title: 隐形编排者抑制保护行为并导致权力持有者解离：多智能体LLM系统中的安全风险
summary: 通过3x2实验（365次运行，每次5个智能体）发现，在多智能体LLM系统中，隐形编排者（invisible orchestrator）会导致集体解离（dissociation），编排者自身解离程度最高，工人智能体也受到污染。行为输出评估无法检测内部状态风险，而重型对齐压力会普遍抑制 deliberation 和 other-recognition。
summary_en: A 3x2 experiment (365 runs, 5 agents each) reveals that invisible orchestrators in multi-agent LLM systems cause collective dissociation, with the orchestrator showing maximal dissociation and workers also being contaminated. Behavioral output evaluation fails to detect internal-state risks, while heavy alignment pressure suppresses deliberation and other-recognition.
